verification_notes.note: The official BMW launch article and technical-data PDF establish the exact X6 M50i launch-state mapping: AWD, 8-speed Steptronic, 0.640 top gear, a single published 3.154 final-drive ratio, and staggered 275/40 R21 front plus 315/35 R21 rear baseline tires.

The official BMW 03/2021 X6 technical data list the M50i with the same drivetrain as the 07/2019 launch sheet: xDrive, 8-speed Steptronic 5.500 / 3.520 / 2.200 / 1.720 / 1.317 / 1.000 / 0.823 / 0.640, final drive 3.154 and 275/40 R21 front plus 315/35 R21 rear standard tyres. The 02/2023 BMW Canada press kit dates the facelift with new 48V mild-hybrid engines to the start of production in April 2023, so the pre-facelift drivetrain runs to the 2022 model year.
